title: Nutty Quick Moroccan Chinese Leaf Amlou
description: A quick-fix Moroccan dish featuring Chinese leaf, with umami and aerated elements, shaped like nigiri and wrapped in pandan leaves.
instructions: Rinse the Chinese leaf and separate the leaves.
In a blender, combine almond paste, honey, orange blossom water, sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Lay a pandan leaf flat and place a small spoonful of the almond paste mixture in the center.
Add a few leaves of Chinese leaf on top of the almond paste mixture.
Fold the pandan leaf over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, like a nigiri.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Place the pandan leaf wraps in the pan, seam-side down, and cook for 2 minutes.
Flip the wraps over and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve the Nutty Quick Moroccan Chinese Leaf Amlou warm or at room temperature.
